description: This file defines the AuthorizationCodeRepository class, which implements methods for handling OAuth authorization codes, including persisting new codes, revoking codes, and checking revocation status within an OAuth2 server context.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth authorization codes, implementing persisting, revoking, and checking revocation status functionalities as part of OAuth2 server operations.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Persists a new OAuth authorization code entity into the database.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Marks an authorization code as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a specific authorization code has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of an authorization code entity.
